text:
48세 여성, Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) severe case admission.  
Respiratory monitoring close 필요.  
BP 118/76 mmHg, HR 98 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min.  
BT 37.5°C, SpO2 89% on room air 확인됨.  
Severe muscle weakness 호소함.  
IV immunoglobulin 0.4 g/kg IV q12h 적용함.  
Non-rebreather mask 산소 적용함.  
Ventilator 사용 중.  
Clinical status: drowsy 상태.  
Neurology team notify함.
